{{Quote|These must be the 'unique items' we were warned about. These assassin droids can be very unpredictable.''"<br />"''They're switched off. They don't look so tough to me.''"<br />"''Nothing looks tough to you. Take my word for it&mdash;they're deadly.|Anakin Skywalker and Ahsoka Tano, encountering a pair of inactive IG-86s aboard the ''Vulture's Claw''|<ref name="Downfall of a Droid">{{TCW|Downfall of a Droid}}</ref>}}
The '''IG-86 sentinel droid''' was a model of [[Assassin droid/Legends|assassin droids]] manufactured by [[Holowan Mechanicals/Legends|Holowan Mechanicals]] as a subsidiary of [[Holowan Laboratories/Legends|Holowan Laboratories]], the same company that created the [[IG-88 assassin droid/Legends|IG-88 assassin droid]]. It was designed to function as a bodyguard, or home security system for the wealthy, but was usually used for more sinister purposes.

==Characteristics==
{{Quote|O Ziro the Hutt, Master of the Hutt Clan on seven systems, I am sorry, Your Highness. It will not happen again.''"<br />"''I know. Take him away, and use him for spare parts!|KRONOS-327 and Ziro the Hutt, after the droid's failure to complete a [[Mission to Yout 12|mission]]|audio=KRONOS327SpareParts-TCWf.flac|<ref name="Star Wars: The Clone Wars (film)">[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (film)|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' film]]</ref>}}
[[File:Ziro_IG86s_TCWCG.jpg|thumb|left|180px|Two IG-86 sentinel droids protect Ziro the Hutt.]]
IG-86 sentinel droids were similar in appearance to the earlier [[IG-series/Legends|IG-series]] droids such as the [[IG lancer droid/Legends|IG lancer combat droid]] and later models such as the [[IG-88 assassin droid/Legends|IG-88 assassin droid]]. Considered to be some of the deadliest droids in the galaxy, they were more intelligent and agile than standard [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]], able to think logically and creatively. They were capable assassins working individually or in groups.
[[File:IG86Lamp-HC.png|thumb|220x220px|IG-86 models have a built in flashlight in their head]]

==History==
{{Quote|After all these years, my most ''trusted'' of assassins has finally failed.|Ziro Desilijic Tiure, on KRONOS-327|audio=KRONOS327Failed-TCWf.flac|<ref name="Star Wars: The Clone Wars (film)" />}}
IG-86 units were owned by [[Ziro Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Ziro]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] and were adorned with a [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] marking, like their master. One of these was [[KRONOS-327/Legends|KRONOS-327]], which was used as a [[Sentry droid/Legends|sentry droid]] by Ziro.<ref name="TCW Visual Guide" />

When [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] were searching for [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] on the [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] [[Vulture's Claw/Legends|''Vulture's Claw'']], owned by the [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] scavenger [[Gha Nachkt/Legends|Gha Nachkt]], they were attacked by a pair of IG-86 droids. Though they demonstrated their exceptional agility, blaster resistance, and firepower, they were destroyed by the two [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] and their [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsabers]]. A third IG-86 unit gave a brief chase to R2-D2, who had broken loose. R2 lured the sentinel droid to the airlock, where the droid was jettisoned out into space shortly afterwards.
[[File:IG-86sVulturesClaw-TCWe06.png|left|thumb|220x220px|A pair of rusted, inactive Assassin Droids]]
Later on, three of these droids were used by [[Cad Bane/Legends|Cad Bane]] during his [[Senate hostage crisis/Legends|capture]] of the [[Senate Building/Legends|Senate Building]]. They bore similar Black Sun markings as those employed by Ziro the Hutt, suggesting that they might have been the Hutt's personal property and not Bane's. Anakin Skywalker, who was not carrying his [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] at the time, destroyed [[Unidentified IG-86 sentinel droid (Cad Bane)/Legends|one]] of the droids by clubbing it with its own blaster rifle. [[HELIOS-3E/Legends|HELIOS-3E]] assist Bane in taking over the Senate building while [[HELIOS-3D/Legends|HELIOS-3D]] drove an [[Airspeeder/Legends|airspeeder]] to pick up Ziro. Previously HELIOS-3E and another IG-86 unit had previously assist Bane on a mission to steal vital information to break into the Senate building. HELIOS-3E went with Bane’s [[Techno-service droid/Legends|techno-service droid]] [[Todo 360/Legends|Todo 360]] to capture both droids, while Bane’s other IG-86 unit aided his modified [[8D smelter droid]] [[J0-N0/Legends|J0-N0]] to [[Torture/Legends|torture]] and hack both droids [[Databank/Legends|databank]].

Some of these droids were known to be used by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]].<ref name="TCW Visual Guide" />
